rows.coder_note: Abstract says only 'derived from the MEGASTROKE GWAS': a consortium name alone with no release, year, accession, citation or sample size (rule D); no accession is given, so rule B does not apply.

Abstract gives '308 plasma proteins (measured in 4,994 blood donors from the INTERVAL study)': exact counts with a cohort name alone, no platform, release, accession or citation (rules D, I1); the counts do not match INTERVAL SomaScan (Sun 2018) and no accession is given, so rule B does not apply.
